newsitem.title: USA: GNI weighing options, including merger.
newsitem.headline: GNI weighing options, including merger.

text.p: The GNI Group Inc said it hired investment bank First Analysis Securities Corp to explore alternatives to increase shareholder value, including a possible merger.
The alternatives may include a merger, joint venture, business combination or other transaction, the waste management company and chemical manufacturer said in a statement.

GNI said on May 14 it expected revenues for the fourth quarter ending June 30 to be "below plan" because of underperformance in the company's chemical manufacturing unit and because of legal and advisory costs relating to "a proposed business combination with an unnamed company."

The company posted a net income of $0.09 per share for its third quarter ended March 31, compared with a loss of $0.75 the year before. Its shares traded at 6 this morning, up 1/4 over Wednesday's close.
